description: Search the Swiss commercial register (Zefix) by company name and receive bounded, deduplicated candidate summaries (UID, legal name, legal form, register status, seat, canton) with source attribution. Use this to find a company's UID before calling get_company_profile, or to review candidates after verify_business reports an ambiguous name. Discovery only: no candidate is selected automatically, results are not ranked or scored, and a name match is not a verification result. For direct one-call verification, use verify_business.

inputSchema.description: Search the Swiss commercial register (Zefix) by company name. Discovery only: returns bounded register candidates; nothing is selected, ranked or verified.

name.description: Company name to search for. Trimmed; 3–300 characters. Do not guess spellings; use the name as claimed.

name: search_companies
title: Search Swiss companies
